preferred_candidate.change: Replace strategy buf_map(bp,&vaddr)/buf_unmap(bp) with paired buf_map_range/ buf_unmap_range. No other data-path change.
preferred_candidate.measurement_gate: Prioritize only if observed map_ticks and clustered/pageio buffer counts are material. map_ticks is elapsed mapping time, not CPU cycles; unmap is not currently timed. No speedup asserted.
evidence: vfs_bio.c:1159-1284: both APIs share exact noncluster and real_bp mapped fast paths; range selects ubc_upl_map_range(bp->b_upl,b_uploffset,b_bcount), legacy maps whole UPL then adds offset.
ubc_subr.c:2640-2713 and vm_user.c:2440-2508 explicitly distinguish whole UPL versus mapped range; VM range rounds page coverage and returns adjusted pointer.
Both unmap APIs share B_AGE behavior and no-op fast paths; range removal uses matched UPL offset/count. Strategy copies exactly count bytes, so it does not need the rest of UPL mapped.
vfs_io_compression_stats.c:389 uses range API for precisely buf_cnt bytes, showing selected XNU caller pattern.
invariants: Preserve mapping before UFS mutex, unmapping after unlock, all residual/error/biodone paths and read/write directions.
Do not add b_uploffset to returned range pointer: VM already adjusts it. Pair range map/unmap, including on command failure.
No DMA ownership/cache/request-size/link change; original bounce buffer remains protected by same mutex.
preferred_candidate.test: Exact XNU mapping/unmapping routines extracted into ASan/UBSan harness PASS across noncluster/real_bp/new cluster, B_READ/B_PAGEIO, nonzero offset, mapping failure and B_AGE/unmap ownership.
preferred_candidate.test_limit: Mock proves API contract/driver-required range, not actual VM scheduling cost or hardware performance.

ioctl_findings.current_early_exit: sweet_ufs_ioctl lacks DKIOCGETFEATURES. spec_ioctl passes ENOTTY through. vfs_init_io_attributes returns at GETFEATURES before applying driver maxblock/segment queries; root mount ignores error with existing defaults.
ioctl_findings.defaults: VFS initializes maxread/maxwrite=MAX_UPL_SIZE_BYTES64MiB; mnt_segread/writecnt remain initial32. Cluster_io independently clips page count to max_vectors; 16KiB pages imply nominal512KiB per fragment, subject to file/extents/other limits.
ioctl_findings.pitfall: Existing driver advertises maxsegmentcount1. Completing all missing ioctls while preserving1 would apply a one-page fragment cap (16KiB) in cluster_io. cluster_max_io_size has a1MiB floor, so that floor does NOT prevent inner fragmentation into16KiB requests.
ioctl_findings.coherent_future_bundle: If histogram shows large contiguous reads split near512KiB and command/setup costs are material: complete GETFEATURES=0, maxbyte<=BOUNCE_SIZE1MiB, maxsegmentcount=0(no extra input-page restriction, VFS derives maxbytes/pages), maxsegmentbytes<=1MiB, minimumalignment0; block limits existing1MiB. Internal PRDT still1–4 contiguous bounce entries; logical input pages are copied, so source-page contiguity is unnecessary. Requires exact vfs_init_io_attributes/cluster_io contract regression, large/fragmented buffers and unchanged data/residual tests before implementation.
ioctl_findings.SSD: DKIOCISSOLIDSTATE also ENOTTY, so HFS_SSD not set; HFS uses this to decide hotfile policy (hfs_vfsops.c:461,1298). Returning true is truthful UFS media metadata, but no evidence identifies current hotfile work as boot bottleneck; do not claim measurable gain.

bounce_cache_findings: UTRD32B and UCD1088B are zeroed per command; bounce is NOT memset for each I/O. Maintenance uses actual rounded transfer bytes, not unconditional1MiB.

Default READ performs bounce pre/post clean+invalidate and a CPU memcpy of requested bytes. Noncoherent DMA requires ownership transitions; dropping invalidation or moving copy outside mutex is not safe.

Existing ufscache=1 narrows descriptor maintenance and uses pre-clean/no-post-invalidate for WRITE only; READ bounce pre/post remains. Mostly-read boot gets descriptor savings, not elimination of2GiB copy or read maintenance.

Partial writes preread the WHOLE rounded chunk if either4KiB edge is partial. Edge-only RMW is a possible later candidate only if rmw_reads plus write-size buckets show substantial over-read. It may add a second command for two edges; no automatic win.

Default ufswait off polls; optional200us sleeping is not a free throughput improvement. One slot and bounce remain serial. No per-IO SCSI sync except explicit sync ioctls; Nord2 persistent UFS logger not started.
interpretation_limits: Do not add command time, map elapsed, copy elapsed and mutex wait totals into a boot critical path: concurrent callers overlap.
Command stats include firmware/vendor and sync calls outside strategy; subtracting all command_ticks from strategy held_ticks is not a valid exact decomposition.

copy_ticks measures CPU memcpy interval; cache maintenance occurs inside command timing before/after doorbell. Mutex held includes serial command service plus copy; wait time alone does not justify releasing shared DMA ownership.
Upcoming strategy map cost may expose scheduler/VA pressure; low map_ticks does not measure unmap. Histograms count requested buffer sizes, not physical contiguous extents.
Previous~7.5s command time vs~47.7s stage6-to-firstGUI cannot establish lane1, UFS or mapping dominance. No runtime CPU-frequency measurement or expected speedup claim.
